features.name: Mail sealed on arrival
features.what: Every inbound mail is encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before it is stored; the server opens it only for you

features.name: Virus scan before the inbox
features.what: ClamAV scans every mail; anything unsafe goes to Quarantine

features.name: Ledger verified in your browser
features.what: The mail ledger chain is re-checked by the WASM kernel in your browser, not trusted from the server
features.tech: Rust WASM kernel, SHA-256 hash chain, Merkle

features.name: Arrival to stored speed
features.what: How long a real mail took from arrival to sealed and stored

features.name: Transport to your browser
features.what: QUIC + WebTransport, HTTP/3 only, DBSC bound session, AES-256 TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768
features.tech: Rust Tokio axum, HTTP/3, WebTransport, ML-KEM

features.name: Passkey touch for risky actions
features.what: Send, key creation and policy changes need a physical key touch on that exact action

features.name: Compose, undo window, outbox
features.what: Write mail, undo before it leaves, scheduled send, sealed drafts

features.name: DKIM dual signature + oversigning
features.what: Ed25519 and RSA-2048 signatures; From, To, Subject, Date, Message-ID signed once more so nothing can be added after

features.name: DKIM key lifecycle and evidence
features.what: Dated selectors, rotation report, DNS check log, signature log, outside-receiver proof, one-way policy switches, send gate
features.tech: PostgreSQL 16 RLS hash chains, Tokio, hickory DNS

features.name: Outgoing TLS to other servers
features.what: Mail leaves over SMTP STARTTLS TLS 1.3 with the post-quantum key exchange; never plain

features.name: Real outgoing mail
features.what: Sender ON: mail leaves 30 seconds after Send (undo hold), signed with DKIM, over TLS 1.3 with the post-quantum key exchange. First real mail reached Gmail 16 Nov 06:15

features.name: Live pulse (Systems)
features.what: Live pulse of the running server every 5 s: server clock, beat number, uptime, build commit and install time, database round trip, Tokio tasks and queue, sending switch; honest Stale badge after 12 s
features.tech: Rust Tokio RuntimeMetrics + Ed25519 signed door verified by the WASM kernel + React

features.name: DKIM evidence chain check
features.what: Button in Systems > Mail signing re-checks the three DKIM evidence hash chains (DNS observations, signature log, receiver proofs) and says how many rows were checked and how many broke
features.tech: Rust Tokio signed door + PostgreSQL hash chains + React

features.name: Sending ON/OFF switch
features.what: Real switch for outgoing mail: OFF = mails wait in the Outbox and nothing is sent, ON = the exact-time sender takes them; every change is a hash-chained ledger line, no touch
features.tech: PostgreSQL policy + Rust Tokio door + React

features.name: DKIM2 / ML-DSA-44
features.what: Next-generation signature with a post-quantum algorithm. Tracked only: no receiver verifies it yet

features.name: Attachments over WebTransport
features.what: Large files in sealed chunks over Tokio + WebTransport + Hetzner Storage Box

features.name: Website framework
features.what: Static single-page app with TanStack Router, Rust backend, one WASM kernel in the browser. TanStack Start (server rendering) is dropped for ever by your decision
